# KnowledgeLeader

> KnowledgeLeader is a comprehensive audit and risk management resource platform offering subscription-based tools, CPE training, publications, and educational programs for audit professionals, students, and academics.

Published by Protiviti, KnowledgeLeader provides audit programs, compliance checklists, control templates, benchmarking reports, and interactive CPE courses covering topics like SOX compliance, internal controls, data analytics, and AI in audit. The platform offers free university access for students and professors alongside premium subscription plans.

## Key Topics

- Risk Management
- Internal Audit
- Compliance
- Internal Controls
- Audit Tools & Programs
- CPE Professional Development
- SOX & Regulatory Compliance
- Data Analytics
- Artificial Intelligence in Audit
- Benchmarking
- PCAOB & SEC Regulations
- Audit Resources
- Protiviti
- Student & Professor Resources
- Data Security
